title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Emversity is India’s largest skill development platform, partnering with higher education institutions and employers to bridge the industry–academia gap. The organization collaborates with more than 12 universities nationwide through industry skilling partnerships. Emversity also owns and operates over 25 skill centers in partnership with NSDC, delivering job\-ready training and upskilling programs. By connecting learners, institutions, and employers, Emversity enables more relevant education, better employability, and stronger industry engagement.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Business Development Manager role based in Kanayannur. The Business Development Manager will identify and pursue new partnerships with universities, training centers, and employers, while nurturing and expanding existing relationships. Daily responsibilities include prospecting and meeting potential partners, presenting Emversity’s solutions, negotiating agreements, and coordinating with internal teams to deliver on partnership commitments. The role also involves conducting market research, preparing sales reports and forecasts, tracking performance metrics, and representing Emversity at events and meetings to enhance brand visibility. The ideal candidate will work closely with leadership to develop regional growth strategies and achieve revenue and partnership targets.
   

**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated ability in business development, sales, or account management, preferably in education, training, or HR services.
* Strong skills in relationship building, stakeholder management, and partnership negotiation.
* Experience in market research, pipeline management, and using CRM or similar tools to track leads and outcomes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage decision\-makers and influence outcomes.
* Strong organizational and planning abilities, including managing multiple opportunities and meeting targets and deadlines.
* Comfort working on\-site with travel as needed for client meetings, events, and partner visits.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in working with universities, training institutions, or corporate L\&D teams is highly beneficial.
* Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., MS Office, spreadsheets, presentation software).
